title: Holomorphic motions, Assouad dimension and quasiconformal mappings
summary: We study the variation of the quasi-Assouad dimension of a set moving under a holomorphic motion. We show that the reciprocal of the quasi-Assouad dimension is inf-harmonic in the sense of Fuhrer--Ransford--Younsi. As a consequence, we obtain quasiconformal distortion bounds for quasi-Assouad dimension as well as an improved version of Smirnov's celebrated theorem on the dimension of quasicircles. Our approach is elementary in that it does not require optimal Sobolev regularity for quasiconformal mappings.
